job.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Assistance Foundations
job.pay_full: $196,000 – $227,000 a year base pay; the role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits and Employee Travel Credits

details.about: Airbnb has grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals. Its Assistance Engineering team builds the tools behind Airbnb's global network of support agents, and Assistance Foundations builds the shared platforms support runs on. The group is forming a dedicated Machine Learning Engineering team, and this Senior Machine Learning Engineer will be one of its founding engineers, building LLM-based and agentic systems for quality, coaching, case intelligence and agent decision support.
duties: Design, build and ship LLM-based and agentic systems, from technical design through experimentation and deployment
Build offline and online evaluation (human-labeled sets, LLM-as-judge, A/B tests)
Curate and engineer the datasets that prompts, fine-tuned models and evaluations depend on
Turn one-off models and prompts into shared components other Foundations teams can adopt
Work with product, design, engineering, data science and support operations teams to find high-impact problems and measure results
Take part in design and code reviews and mentor other engineers
needs: 5+ years of industry experience building and shipping applied machine learning, or a PhD in a related field plus 2+ years in industry
Recent, hands-on experience building LLM-based systems that shipped to production
Expertise in prompt design and iteration, fine-tuning and LLM evaluation
Expertise in RAG patterns, memory, tool use and agent planning
Experience integrating LLMs with APIs, vector databases and orchestration frameworks
A solid machine learning foundation: modeling, evaluation design, experimentation and A/B testing
A track record of shipping AI products used by real users
Strong programming in Python, Java or Kotlin, and the skills to productionize your work (model serving, monitoring, data pipelines, safe deployment)
Bachelor's and/or Master's/PhD degree, preferably in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
details.benefits: Base pay range $196,000 – $227,000 a year; actual pay depends on training, skills, experience, business needs and market demands. The role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits and Employee Travel Credits.
notes: US - Remote Eligible: you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity (Airbnb publishes a list of excluded states)
May include occasional work at an Airbnb office or offsites, as agreed with your manager
Airbnb recruiters only email from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com and never ask candidates for money or bank details
